name: Import program members (bulk)
summary: Import a large CSV/TSV/SSV file of program member records into a specific program with a specific status (insert or update). Every row must include an email.
whenToUse: Adding/refreshing many program members at once. For a few leads use 'Add to List' or 'Set program member status' instead. The first row must be a header of REST API names.
notes: File must be under 10 MB and start with a header row of REST API names.
Every row must include the email field — it is used to match leads.
The status you choose must already exist on the program (e.g. 'On List', 'Influenced', 'Completed').
The job runs asynchronously; check back in a few seconds/minutes.
After completion, open 'Failures' and/or 'Warnings' to see exactly which rows had issues and why.

form.name: programId
form.label: Program ID
form.hint: Find it in the 'Programs' group (List programs).

form.name: programMemberStatus
form.label: Program status to set
form.hint: Must be a status that exists on this program, e.g. 'On List', 'Influenced', 'Completed'.

form.name: file
form.label: Member data file
form.hint: CSV/TSV/SSV under 10 MB. First row = REST API names; must include email.
